desc: Paper Mario 64's Spin Dash (#51) in Petal Meadows: a tap of L from standing with the stick let go spins Mario where he stands, as Paper Mario's (25 of Paper Mario's frames, 48 of ours spinning free, the first 32 at twice the run's speed, then slowing; then on to face the way he went), and from a run, the stick held, he spins away its way and keeps it; the log gives each spin's distance
log_must: \[spin\] Mario's spin ends \([^)]*\): \d+ units in \d+ frames
\[spin\] Mario's spin ends \(its end\): 0 units in \d+ frames
\[spin\] Mario's spin ends \(its end\): \d\d+ units in \d+ frames, at \(-?\d+, 0, -10\)
